NPU27547 is a specific laboratory code used within the Danish healthcare system for the measurement of [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. In the context of national quality assurance efforts managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code plays a critical role in tracking clinical quality indicators for patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. 

Specifically, NPU27547 is one of several designated laboratory codes that qualify as a completed TSH measurement for "Indicator 3" in the "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (AFDK) 2024 report [^src1]. When healthcare providers register this code, it contributes to the numerator and denominator calculations used to evaluate whether patients are receiving the required diagnostic workups, which are essential for safely managing the condition [^src1]. The code is listed alongside several other acceptable identifiers (such as NPU04199 and DNK35895) in the technical guidelines that dictate how these quality metrics are recorded and calculated in national health registries [^src1].
